verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at https://pika.art/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured overview of Pika's apps and models. The developer platform also publishes its own llms.txt, per-operation machine-readable spec pages (/llms/{vendor}/{model}/{function}) and an OpenAPI 3.1.0 document, so an agent has clear agent-oriented docs to read. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents actually consume these docs well.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document ("Pika API", server https://api.dev.pika.art), linked as rel="service-desc", plus llms.txt, per-operation machine-readable spec pages (/llms/{vendor}/{model}/{function})
